shared_elements: bird or bird-headed form in profile
horizontal row of repeated signs or geometric marks near the upper part
schematic linear bodies with outlined limbs
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces use schematic profile figures beneath or beside rows of repeated small signs, with at least some bird-like/profile forms and circular signs. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by separate animals and geometric bands, while B shows a coherent human/anthropomorphic ritual scene with standing figures facing one another and holding or attending objects.
